candidates.description: Inspect the current order rows and their column names.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
cur = con.execute('SELECT * FROM orders')
print('Columns:', [column[0] for column in cur.description])
for row in cur:
    print(row)
con.close()
PY

candidates.description: Inspect the database schema and any triggers associated with orders.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/data/orders.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
for row in con.execute('SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY type, name'):
    print(row)
con.close()
PY
